content.short: Crypto exchange running since 2018 with futures, spot and TradFi markets like gold and oil.
content.description: WEEX offers one account for crypto spot and futures alongside traditional markets such as gold and oil. It has operated since 2018, reports 10 million users, and runs trading campaigns, an affiliate programme and AI trading features. Users can deposit and withdraw stablecoins over Plasma as well as the usual networks.
